caseNameFull: Gottschalk, Acting Commissioner of Patents v. Benson

opinions.text:
C. C. P. A. [Certiorari granted, 405 U. S. 915.] Motion of Computer Software Analysts, Inc., et al. for leave to file an untimely brief as amici curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice Blackmun, and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
